fish
/obj/item/organ/external/tail/fish

Tail for fish DNA-infused spacemen. It provides a speed buff while in water. It's also needed for the crawl speed bonus once the threshold is reached.

Vars

fillet_amountThe amount of fillets this gets processed into
fillet_typeThe fillet type this fish tail is processable into

Procs

check_locationGives the owner faster movement and actions while standing in water, removes them when leaving it
on_gibber_processedAdds some extra fish fillets to the gibber results when the owner is gibbed
